v: Sharmaaaa... Varmaaaaa... manakenti ee KHARMA!!! 😭 Story familiar aina screenplay/directing save cheyyali ga... ikkada PK quirks ni కూడా overkill chesesaru.
e: Agnyaathavaasi frustrated me because even if the core story was familiar, the screenplay and direction still had every opportunity to make it work. A few trademark Trivikram lines survive, but weak staging drains their impact, while Pawan Kalyan’s deliberately eccentric performance is stretched so far that what might have been fun in one scene becomes exhausting across a full film.
body:
Cinema Story elago inspired ayinapudu…….kanesam screenplay & direction medhana focus petalsindhi…….Trivikram mark dialogues konni unna worst direction vala vati value lekunda poyindhi!!! PK ki perfect ga vachina ekayka acting gay performance adhi cinema lo oka scene unte fans enjoy chestharu gaani cinema motham unte rotha puduthundi!!!! Trivikram style lo ne cinema gurunchi chepali ante 》》 Sharmaaaa…..Varmaaaaa……maanakenti ee Kharma!!!!

PS : Naa venaka seat lo oka aunty cinema lo prathi scene ki thega navvesi pedha pedha ga arusthu thega irritate chesindhi (bahusa Jabardasth effect anukunta?) , cinema ayyipoyaka mathram cinema thala thoka lekunda chala chetha ga undi anndi, mundu amme thalakayi pagalagottali…….. 😛

v: BHAI can carry routine movies with presence... but Tubelight needed Salman to disappear into the character. Naaku మాత్రం BHAI ni marchipoyi Laxman ni nammadam jaragaledu 😄
e: Tubelight asks Salman Khan to carry an offbeat emotional story through innocence, childishness and vulnerability rather than star power. I respect his wholehearted effort, but Kabir Khan’s casting never convinced me: fans struggle to accept Bhai as a fragile ‘Tubelight,’ while neutral viewers struggle to forget Bhai long enough to believe the character.
body:
watched TubeLight……

Salman Khan the BHAI……can earn you hundreds of crores even with medicore routine subjects and depend solely on his Screen Presence like Dabang, Ready & Prem Ratan Dhan Payo!!!!

but that doesnt mean that Salman Khan the ACTOR….cannot earn you even a single crore with Scripts which are offbeat and depend solely on his ACTING capabilities like Tube Light!!!

Bhajarangi was a runaway hit with its strong storyline packed with various emotions and doesnt rely on Bhaijan’s acting talent…..and Salman’s screen presence has just elevated it to Blockbuster!!!

but TubeLight script itself has to rely on Lakshman’s emotions, Bonding and Childishness……thats exactly where Kabir Khan has failed completely in casting Salman. With Salman onboard (TUBE)light was thrown on scripts loopholes rather than putting them in Dark.

with due respect to Salman’s whole hearted efforts to fill the shoes of Lakshman aka TubeLight…….but we cannot imagine Salman trying to replicate Kamal Hasan’s performance at railway station in Sadma’s climax.

Bottom Line : Neither Fans accept Bhai being a Tubelight nor regular audience digest the fact that Tubelight is being played by Bhai!!!!

v: Old Sarkar magic malli raledu... but Govinda BGM, Nagre aura, weird RGV angles and a few solid lines make this a decent return. Home ki raaledu, road మాత్రం dorikindi 😄
e: Sarkar 3 suffers mainly because both the genre and Subhash Nagre’s world have become deeply familiar. RGV does not reinvent the formula, so viewers expecting another landmark are bound to be disappointed; still, the film contains all the genre ingredients and felt to me like a filmmaker who had not reached home again, but had at least rediscovered the road back.
body:
watched #Sarkar3……the major problem with the GodFather genre is the story and charachterizations gets repeatable and predicatable. after the first installment of Sarkar, various filmmakers makers have tried to exploit it and the genre is beaten to death!!

with RGV going back to Sarkar….many of us would have expected him to give a new angle & definition to the genre…..unfortunately he doesnt and thats where i see lot of negative reactions just because the expectations were too high!!!! I would bet the movie (taken as it is) would have become a good hit if RGV was not associated, such is the expectation on him

on that note….Sarkar3 has all the elements that are required for the genre. Powerful & Philosphical Oneliners, Shopisticated Business Men, Corrupted Politicians, Slow Camera Moments, Weird Camera Angles and our own Govinda Govinda Goooovinda!!!!!

RGV did directional justification to the movie, but being the 3rd part of the movie…..ppl are accustomed to Subash Nagre’s Black Dress, White Beard and Silent Killer Looks and the Govinda Govinda BGM, hence as audience we definetly miss the WOW factor which we experienced watching Sarkar for the very first time.

From past few years, RGV has completly lost his golden touch ( in audience perspective) in film making & focusing on social media controversies…..with Sarkar3 though he is not back home, he has definetly found way back!!!

PS : considering RGV’s contribution…..he has worked and focused a lot these years on slow motions, camera angles and different types of camers. I think its time he should try to uncover something new in film making & story telling process which will awe the audience & film makers!!!!

v: Rajamouli elevations + emotions + Keeravani BGM = full blast 🔥 Rana and Anushka are the real pillars here. Logic pakkana petti experience ni enjoy cheyyandi.
e: Baahubali 2 doubles down on everything Rajamouli does best: emotional payoff, larger-than-life elevations and brilliantly staged action powered by M.M. Keeravani’s score. Anushka’s Devasena and Rana’s Bhallaladeva dominate the concluding chapter, while the story takes centre stage strongly enough to answer anyone who felt the first film’s spectacle overshadowed its narrative.
body:
The Conclusion, Rajamouli played to his strengths, aaa elevation scenes gaani aaa emotions gaani _/\_ and with Keeravani deadly BGM its _/\_ _/\_ assalu supporting charachter chesina SubbaRaj ki guda 2 elevation shots petti full impact create chesadu

Anushka (Deva Sena)& Rana (Bhallala Deva) are the pillars of the concluding part…..assalu Rana terrific acting (expressions) mukhyam ga Bahubali ni champinapudu aythe _/\_ _/\_

assalu first part chusi…..2nd part lo Sivagami char terrific ga untundi anukunte, Deva Sena char inka terrific ga chupinchi simple ga Sivagami ni papa pakkaki elli aadukommaaa annaadu 🙂

Title Cards lo speciality chupinchali ante oka Sukumar valle avuthundi anukunaa but Rajamouli proved me wrong…….Fights lo logic ni pakana pedithe Terrific ga tesaadu……RGV Shiva tarvatha Chain ni fight sequence lo superb ga vadindhi indhulo climax fight lonee 🙂

First part chusi Story ni Graphics dominate chesayi anni complaint chesi……Second part lo Graphics ni Story dominate chesindi ani complaint chese konnimandi goppollu evaru aythe unnaro…….meeru elli dubbing cinemalu chusukondi poyi
